[POL-LOY-011-s09-c01] 4. Tier Benefits
## 4. Tier Benefits | Benefit | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Platinum | |---|---|---|---|---| | Points earn rate | 1× | 1.25× | 1.5× | 2× | | Birthday reward | $5 | $10 | $20 | $40 | | Free standard shipping | $75+ | $50+ | Always | Always | | Free return shipping | No | No | Yes | Yes | | Return window | 30 days | 30 days | 30 days | **60 days** | | Early access to sales | No | 12 hours | 24 hours | 48 hours | | Free gear repair | No | No | 2 per year | Unlimited | | Dedicated support line | No | No | No | Yes | | Annual gear credit | No | No | No | $100 | Benefits are tied to the member's tier at the time the benefit is used, except the return window, which is fixed at the tier held **at the time of purchase** (see POL-RET-004 §1.1).

[POL-LOY-011-s06-c01] 3. Points
## 3. Points Members earn **1 point per $1** of qualifying merchandise spend. | Tier | Earn rate | Effective value | |---|---|---| | Bronze | 1× | 1 point per $1 | | Silver | 1.25× | 1.25 points per $1 | | Gold | 1.5× | 1.5 points per $1 | | Platinum | 2× | 2 points per $1 | **100 points = $5** in redemption value. Points may be redeemed in increments of 100, in store or online, and may be combined with promotions unless a promotion states otherwise.

[POL-LOY-011-s02-c01] 2. Tiers
## 2. Tiers Tier is determined by **trailing 12-month spend**, evaluated on the first day of each month. | Tier | Trailing 12-month spend | Members (approx.) | |---|---|---| | **Bronze** | Under $500 | 61% | | **Silver** | $500 – $1,999.99 | 26% | | **Gold** | $2,000 – $4,999.99 | 10% | | **Platinum** | $5,000 and above | 3% | Spend counts merchandise only. Gift card purchases, taxes, shipping charges, and amounts refunded through returns do **not** count toward tier qualification. A return reduces trailing spend and can cause a tier downgrade.

[POL-LOY-011-s10-c01] 4.1 Annual Gear Credit
### 4.1 Annual Gear Credit Platinum members receive a **$100 gear credit** each January 1. The credit expires December 31 of the same year, does not carry over, has no cash value, and is forfeited if the member is downgraded below Platinum before using it. ---

[POL-RET-004-s11-c01] 6.3 Mexico Locations
### 6.3 Mexico Locations Merchandise purchased in Mexico may be returned only to a Mexico location, and merchandise purchased in the US or Canada may not be returned to a Mexico location. This restriction is due to customs and tax handling and cannot be waived by store staff. ---

[POL-RET-004-s06-c01] 4. Non-Returnable Merchandise
## 4. Non-Returnable Merchandise The following are **final sale** and cannot be returned or exchanged under any circumstance, including for Platinum members and including during the holiday window: - Items marked **"Final Sale"** on the product page or receipt - Clearance merchandise discounted **50% or more** from original retail - Personalized or custom-embroidered items - Perishable goods, including trail food and fuel canisters - Undergarments, swimwear, and socks, if the hygiene seal is broken - Gift cards and digital products - Downloadable trip guides and map subscriptions **This section overrides all other sections of this policy, including the Platinum extended window and the holiday window.** No tier benefit, promotional offer, or service gesture creates a right of return for final sale merchandise. ---

[POL-SHP-007-s07-c01] 5.2 Mexico
### 5.2 Mexico Mexico orders ship from the Monterrey distribution center and carry a separate rate card. Free shipping thresholds **do not apply to Mexico orders** regardless of tier. Transit is 7–10 business days. Overnight service is not available.

[POL-LOY-011-s11-c01] 5. Promotional Offers
## 5. Promotional Offers Targeted offers issued to a member are **single-use, non-transferable, and tied to the member account**. Offers may not be stacked with other targeted offers, though a targeted offer may generally be combined with points redemption. Offer codes are void if the account is closed, if the offer's stated conditions are not met, or after the stated expiry date. Expired offers **cannot be reinstated by customer service or by any automated system.**
